A dashed green line, labeled “Recall@50 (ReFICR)”, begins at approximately 0.47 at x=1 and remains relatively constant at approximately 0.47 through x=5. A solid blue line, labeled “NDCG@50 (Ours)”, begins at approximately 0.32 at x=1 and increases to approximately 0.44 at x=5.
